title: Add 4 configurable TUI color schemes
body:
- [x] Add `ColorScheme` field to `Config` in `internal/config/config.go`
- [x] Rewrite `internal/tui/styles.go` with `ColorScheme` struct, 4 schemes, and `SetColorScheme()`
- [x] Call `SetColorScheme(cfg.ColorScheme)` in `NewModel` in `internal/tui/model.go`
- [x] Update `README.md` with `color_scheme` documentation
- [x] Resolve merge conflicts with master (row highlighting + pagination feature)
